vim9script

# plugins.vim - Asynchronous Vim9 Plugin Manager
var plugin_dir = expand('~/.vim/plugged')

g:plugins = [
      \ 'junegunn/fzf',
      \ 'junegunn/fzf.vim',
      \ 'yegappan/lsp',
      \ 'ojroques/vim-oscyank',
      \ 'itchyny/lightline.vim',
      \ 'elixir-editors/vim-elixir',
      \ 'mhinz/vim-signify',
      \ 'aklt/plantuml-syntax',
      \ 'iamcco/markdown-preview.nvim',
      \ 'eddy147/gemini.vim',
      \ 'catppuccin/vim'
      \ ]

# 1. Startup: Register installed plugins without performing network work.
def EnsurePlugins()
  for repo in g:plugins
    var name = split(repo, '/')[-1]->substitute('\.git$', '', '')
    var path = plugin_dir .. '/' .. name

    if !isdirectory(path)
      echohl WarningMsg
      echom printf('[plugins.vim] Missing %s — run :PluginInstall', repo)
      echohl None
      continue
    endif

    execute 'set runtimepath+=' .. fnameescape(path)
  endfor
enddef

EnsurePlugins()

# 2. Explicitly install any missing plugins.
def InstallMyPlugins()
  if !isdirectory(plugin_dir)
    mkdir(plugin_dir, 'p')
  endif

  for repo in g:plugins
    var name = split(repo, '/')[-1]->substitute('\.git$', '', '')
    var path = plugin_dir .. '/' .. name

    if !isdirectory(path)
      echom printf('[PluginInstall] Cloning %s...', repo)
      system(['git', 'clone', '--depth=1',
            \ 'https://github.com/' .. repo .. '.git', path])
    endif
  endfor

  echom '[PluginInstall] Done. Restart Vim to load newly installed plugins.'
enddef

command! PluginInstall InstallMyPlugins()

# 3. Async parallel updates for installed plugins.
def UpdateMyPlugins()
  var active_jobs = 0
  var total = len(g:plugins)

  echom printf('[PluginUpdate] Starting parallel update for %d plugins...', total)

  for repo in g:plugins
    var name = split(repo, '/')[-1]->substitute('\.git$', '', '')
    var path = $'"{plugin_dir}/{name}"'

    if !isdirectory(expand(path[1 : -2]))
      echom printf('[%s] Not installed.', name)
      continue
    endif

    var cmd = $'git -C {path} pull --ff-only --stat=count'
    active_jobs += 1

    job_start(['sh', '-c', cmd], {
      out_cb: (channel, msg) => {
        var clean_msg = substitute(msg, '[\r\n]\+', ' ', 'g')
        if clean_msg !~# 'Already up-to-date' && !empty(clean_msg)
          echom printf('[%s] Updated: %s', name, clean_msg)

          # Auto-helptags on update
          var doc_dir = expand(path[1 : -2]) .. '/doc'
          if isdirectory(doc_dir)
            execute 'helptags ' .. fnameescape(doc_dir)
          endif

          # Auto-rebuild markdown-preview if updated
          if name ==# 'markdown-preview.nvim'
            echom '[markdown-preview.nvim] Rebuilding app binaries...'
            job_start(['sh', '-c', $'cd {path}/app && ./install.sh'])
          endif
        endif
      },
      exit_cb: (job, status) => {
        active_jobs -= 1
        if active_jobs == 0
          echom '[PluginUpdate] All plugins updated!'
        endif
      }
    })
  endfor
enddef

command! PluginUpdate UpdateMyPlugins()

function! s:CopyFilePathToClipboard()
  let l:path = expand('%:p')

function! s:InspectHighlightUnderCursor()
  let l:id = synID(line('.'), col('.'), 1)
  let l:syntax = synIDattr(l:id, 'name')
  let l:resolved = synIDattr(synIDtrans(l:id), 'name')

  if empty(l:syntax)
    let l:syntax = 'NONE'
  endif

  if empty(l:resolved)

function! s:GitBlameCurrentLine()
  let l:file = expand('%:p')

  if empty(l:file)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'Git blame: no file in current buffer.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  if !executable('git')
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'Git blame: `git` is not installed.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  let l:line = line('.')
  let l:dir = fnamemodify(l:file, ':h')
  let l:name = fnamemodify(l:file, ':t')

  execute '!git -C ' . shellescape(l:dir) . ' blame -L ' . l:line . ',' . l:line . ' -- ' . shellescape(l:name)
endfunction

function! s:PlantumlCommand(file, format, outdir)
  let l:format_flag = ' -t' . a:format
  let l:out_flag = ' -o ' . shellescape(a:outdir)

  if executable('plantuml')
    return 'plantuml' . l:format_flag . l:out_flag . ' ' . shellescape(a:file)
  endif

  if executable('docker')
    let l:dir = fnamemodify(a:file, ':h')
    let l:name = fnamemodify(a:file, ':t')
    return 'docker run --rm -v ' . shellescape(l:dir) . ':/workspace -v /tmp:/tmp -w /workspace plantuml/plantuml' . l:format_flag . l:out_flag . ' ' . shellescape(l:name)
  endif

  return ''
endfunction

function! s:PlantumlExport(format, outdir)
  let l:file = expand('%:p')

  if empty(l:file)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: no file in current buffer.' | echohl None
    return ''
  endif

  let l:cmd = s:PlantumlCommand(l:file, a:format, a:outdir)

  if empty(l:cmd)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: install `plantuml` or Docker.' | echohl None
    return ''
  endif

  call system(l:cmd)

  if v:shell_error
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML export failed.' | echohl None
    return ''
  endif

  " Path where PlantUML placed the file
  let l:output_file = a:outdir . '/' . fnamemodify(l:file, ':t:r') . '.' . a:format
  echom 'PlantUML exported: ' . l:output_file
  return l:output_file
endfunction

function! s:PlantumlPreview()
  " Export directly to /tmp
  let l:image = s:PlantumlExport('png', '/tmp')

  if empty(l:image) || v:shell_error
    return
  endif

  if !filereadable(l:image)
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: preview image not found in /tmp.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  if !executable('xdg-open')
    echohl ErrorMsg | echom 'PlantUML: install xdg-open to preview.' | echohl None
    return
  endif

  call system('xdg-open ' . shellescape(l:image) . ' >/dev/null 2>&1 &')
  echom 'PlantUML preview opened: ' . l:image

" Convert identifier styles without changing registers or search history.
function! s:ConvertToken(token, style) abort
  let l:prefix = matchstr(a:token, '^_*')
  let l:suffix = matchstr(a:token, '_*$')
  let l:core = strpart(a:token, strlen(l:prefix),
        \ strlen(a:token) - strlen(l:prefix) - strlen(l:suffix))
  if empty(l:core)
    return a:token
  endif

  if a:style ==# 'camel'
    if l:core !~# '_'
      return a:token
    endif
    if l:core ==# toupper(l:core)
      let l:core = tolower(l:core)
    endif
    let l:core = substitute(l:core, '_\([A-Za-z0-9]\)', '\u\1', 'g')
    let l:core = tolower(strpart(l:core, 0, 1)) . strpart(l:core, 1)
  else
    if l:core !~# '\C\%([a-z0-9][A-Z]\|[A-Z][A-Z][a-z]\)'
      return a:token
    endif
    let l:core = substitute(l:core, '\C\([A-Z]\)\([A-Z][a-z]\)', '\1_\2', 'g')
    let l:core = substitute(l:core, '\C\([a-z0-9]\)\([A-Z]\)', '\1_\2', 'g')
    let l:core = tolower(l:core)
  endif

  return l:prefix . l:core . l:suffix
endfunction

function! s:ConvertText(text, style) abort
  return substitute(a:text, '[A-Za-z0-9_]\+',
        \ '\=s:ConvertToken(submatch(0), a:style)', 'g')
endfunction

function! s:ConvertWord(style) abort
  let l:text = getline('.')
  let l:cursor = col('.') - 1
  let l:offset = 0
  while l:offset < strlen(l:text)
    let [l:word, l:start, l:end] = matchstrpos(l:text, '\k\+', l:offset)
    if l:start < 0 || l:start > l:cursor
      return
    endif
    if l:cursor < l:end
      call setline('.', strpart(l:text, 0, l:start)
            \ . s:ConvertText(l:word, a:style) . strpart(l:text, l:end))
      return
    endif
    let l:offset = l:end
  endwhile
endfunction

function! s:ConvertSelection(style) abort
  let l:regions = getregionpos(getpos("'<"), getpos("'>"),
        \ {'type': visualmode()})
  for [l:first, l:last] in l:regions
    if l:first[2] == 0 || l:last[2] == 0
      continue
    endif
    let l:text = getline(l:first[1])
    let l:start = l:first[2] - 1
    let l:end = l:last[2] - 1
    " A partially selected tab or wide character is outside the conversion.
    if l:first[3] > 0
      let l:start += strlen(matchstr(strpart(l:text, l:start), '^.'))
    endif
    if l:last[3] == 0
      let l:end += strlen(matchstr(strpart(l:text, l:end), '^.'))
    endif
    if l:end <= l:start
      continue
    endif
    call setline(l:first[1], strpart(l:text, 0, l:start)
          \ . s:ConvertText(strpart(l:text, l:start, l:end - l:start), a:style)
          \ . strpart(l:text, l:end))
  endfor
endfunction

" The Visual command-line prefix distinguishes a selection from a line range.
let s:case_visual = 0
augroup CaseConversion
  autocmd!
  autocmd CmdlineLeave : let s:case_visual = getcmdline() =~# "^'<,'>\\s*\\%(CamelCase\\|SnakeCase\\)\\>"
augroup END

function! s:ConvertRange(first, last, style) abort
  if s:case_visual
    let s:case_visual = 0
    call s:ConvertSelection(a:style)
  else
    for l:line in range(a:first, a:last)
      call setline(l:line, s:ConvertText(getline(l:line), a:style))
    endfor
  endif
endfunction

command! -range CamelCase call <SID>ConvertRange(<line1>, <line2>, 'camel')
command! -range SnakeCase call <SID>ConvertRange(<line1>, <line2>, 'snake')
